reason: Money is tight since daycare went up, and we do library storytime, parks and the zoo for free. $13 a visit adds up fast and I can get my own coffee at home.
objection: Paying $13 a kid, every visit, for something that's basically a play area when the library and parks cost nothing. Even $45 a month is a lot for us right now.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $6 to $8 a kid, or a rainy-day or winter deal that makes it cheap enough to go once in a while. I'd take the free first visit, but that's not buying.
